subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting principal and authorized per-user usage view now, and should that design depend on the Gateway identity work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43903, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92367, and related WebChat identity issues?
rationale: Per-user token accounting is identity, billing, and authorization sensitive, and current usage telemetry plus origin metadata are not enough to decide who can view whose activity or spend.

options.title: Define Core Accounting Principal
options.body: Define the Gateway/Core accounting subject and viewer-permission model, then extend usage RPCs and Dashboard reporting around it.

options.title: Wait For Principal Design
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until scoped-token, trusted-proxy, and WebChat sender identity work settles the caller identity model.

options.title: External Reporting For Now
options.body: Document separate gateways or external provider dashboards as the supported path until core multi-user accounting is designed.

recommendation.title: Define Core Accounting Principal
recommendation.body: Define the Gateway/Core accounting subject and viewer-permission model, then extend usage RPCs and Dashboard reporting around it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across usage summaries, diagnostics/security docs, and shared usage/auth helper boundaries.
